T005-C01.comparison_tolerance: public table displays 12 decimals (rounding half-unit 0.0000000000005); certified witness is lower by 3385317/250000000000000000 (1.3541268e-11)
limitations: Restored the public radii and reduced each one by the minimum feasible common amount on the 1e-18 grid: 260409/500000000000000000. The witness is exactly feasible by Fraction arithmetic; the immediately smaller grid value fails at least one constraint.
The Packomania coordinate decimals are rounded source data. This conservative replay is not an exact reproduction of the displayed objective.
The public table value is a best-known record, not a proof of optimality.

reproduction_method.algorithm: Exact Fraction monotone binary search for the smallest common radius decrement on the 1e-18 grid; feasibility checks all four walls and all n(n-1)/2 pair distances.

verification.source_review: Packomania same-parameter public coordinates; exact strict and independent sum/constraints verified. Minimum 1e-18-grid radius reduction is certified; public-value gap is retained.
